description: This file defines the ApproximateActionListener class, a JobListener implementation in Apache Spark that handles approximate single-result actions such as count() or reduce(), providing partial results within a specified timeout.

classes.name: ApproximateActionListener
classes.description: A JobListener for approximate single-result actions that provides partial results within a timeout.

methods.name: taskSucceeded
methods.description: Handles successful task completion, merging results and notifying when all tasks are finished.

methods.name: jobFailed
methods.description: Handles job failure by recording the exception and notifying waiting threads.

methods.name: awaitResult
methods.description: Waits up to the specified timeout for the job to complete or partial result, returning the current partial result.
